parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS node
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block of the VSwitch. The following requirements apply:

The prefix length must be an integer from 16 to 29.

The CIDR block of the VSwitch must be a subset of the CIDR block of the VPC to which the VSwitch belongs.

The CIDR block of the VSwitch cannot be the same as the destination CIDR block of an existing route in the VPC, but it can be a subset of the destination CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
交换机的网段。交换机网段要求如下：
交换机的网段的掩码长度范围为16~29位。
交换机的网段必须从属于所在VPC的网段。
交换机的网段不能与所在VPC中路由条目的目标网段相同，但可以是目标网段的子集
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VSwitch. The following requirements apply:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.

The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Default value: an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
交换机名称。命名规则如下：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

默认值：空
parameters.name: vswitch_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VSwitch.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
交换机的描述信息。

描述长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network to which the VSwitch belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的交换机所属的网络ID
parameters.name: network_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.

The tag key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters long.

The tag key cannot be an empty string
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。

不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
最多支持64个字符。
不允许传入空字符串
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. It can be up to 128 characters long, can be an empty string, and cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签值。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value
